-- cross join user and date
with dates as (
    select
        dates.date_day,
        users.user_id,
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(dates.date_day as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(users.user_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as daily_user_id

    from DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.dim_dates as dates
    cross join DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.dim_users as users
    where dates.date_day between users.first_event_date and users.last_event_date
)

select
    dates.*,
    active_check.user_id is not null as is_active,
    coalesce(event_data.number_of_events, 0) as number_of_events

from dates
left join DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_users_activities_date_aggregated as active_check
    on dates.date_day between active_check.event_date and active_check.active_end_date
        and dates.user_id = active_check.user_id
left join DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_users_activities_date_aggregated as event_data
    on dates.date_day = event_data.event_date
        and dates.user_id = event_data.user_id

select
    daily_user_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_daily_users
where daily_user_id is not null
group by daily_user_id
having count(*) > 1

select daily_user_id
from DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_daily_users
where daily_user_id is null

select *
from (
    with pruned_rows as (
      select
        daily_user_id
      from DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_daily_users
      
        where daily_user_id is not null
        limit 1
      
    )
    select
        
        
      
      count(daily_user_id) as filler_column

    from pruned_rows

    

    having count(daily_user_id) = 0

) validation_errors

with monthly_aggregated as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', date_day) as date_month,
        user_id,
        sum(case when is_active then 1 else 0 end) as active_days_count,
        sum(case when not is_active then 1 else 0 end) as inactive_days_count,
        sum(case when is_active then 1 else 0 end) > 0 as has_active_days,
        sum(case when not is_active then 1 else 0 end) > 0 as has_inactive_days,
        sum(number_of_events) as number_of_events
    from DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_daily_users
    group by 1,2
),

with_previous_month as (
    select
        *,
        lag(has_active_days) over (partition by user_id order by date_month) as was_active_previous_month
    from monthly_aggregated
),

user_first_month as (
    select
        user_id,
        min(date_month) as first_month
    from monthly_aggregated
    where has_active_days
    group by 1
)

select
    ma.date_month,
    ma.user_id,
    ma.active_days_count,
    ma.inactive_days_count,
    ma.has_active_days,
    ma.has_inactive_days,
    ma.number_of_events,
    ufm.first_month as user_first_month,

    coalesce(wpm.was_active_previous_month, false) as was_active_previous_month,
    case when ufm.first_month = ma.date_month then true else false end as is_new_user,

    -- Transition type logic
    case
        when wpm.was_active_previous_month is null and ma.has_active_days then 'New'
        when wpm.was_active_previous_month and ma.has_active_days then 'Retained'
        when wpm.was_active_previous_month and not ma.has_active_days then 'Churned'
        when not coalesce(wpm.was_active_previous_month, false) and ma.has_active_days then 'Reactivated'
        else 'Inactive'
    end as transition_type,

    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(ma.date_month as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(ma.user_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as monthly_user_id

from monthly_aggregated ma
left join with_previous_month wpm
    on ma.user_id = wpm.user_id
    and ma.date_month = wpm.date_month
left join user_first_month ufm
    on ma.user_id = ufm.user_id

select monthly_user_id
from DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_monthly_users
where monthly_user_id is null

select *
from (
    with pruned_rows as (
      select
        monthly_user_id
      from DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_monthly_users
      
        where monthly_user_id is not null
        limit 1
      
    )
    select
        
        
      
      count(monthly_user_id) as filler_column

    from pruned_rows

    

    having count(monthly_user_id) = 0

) validation_errors

select
    monthly_user_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DATAMARTS_DEV.james_nguyen.fct_monthly_users
where monthly_user_id is not null
group by monthly_user_id
having count(*) > 1
